notes.title: Update #9
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Highscore fix: highscore display, already displayed text, best stat weights, wrong stats displayed
[*] Tile fix: image selection
[*] Quinn’s VFX loop fixed during attack preparation
[*] Fixed Quinn’s bug where the boss attack range wasn’t displayed
[*] Tile fix: when selecting a tile, updates the description of the newly selected tile
[*] Automatic introduction of the professor in English or French without pressing buttons
[*] Visual problem with lasers fixed
[*] Camera clipping into the environment when moving backward during combat has been fixed
[*] Combat phase 3 speed increased
[*] Boss combat phase 1 speed increased
[/list]

notes.title: Update #6
notes.content:
[h1]Update #6[/h1]
[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
[list]
[*]Boss can be killed directly at the final phase without destroying the fans
[*]Magic counter now works in the highscore
[*]Fixed skill loop for C3D1
[*]Leaderboard can no longer be exited
[*]Boss renamed from "vt" to "quinn"
[*]Restarting on C3D2 causes the game to bug
[/list]
[h2]Additions :[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added sounds: selection button / navigation button
[/list]
[h2]Changes :[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the weight of the leaderboard attributes
[/list]
